pattern.short_summary: At least one end of the interaction loop lives in matter rather than pixels: objects are grasped, moved, or posed to issue commands, or the system's output is delivered as physical motion, staged space, or a tangible arrangement.
pattern.definition: At least one end of the interaction loop lives in matter rather than pixels: objects are grasped, moved, or posed to issue commands, or the system's output is delivered as physical motion, staged space, or a tangible arrangement. The screen is displaced from that end of the loop.
pattern.structural_signature: Either the sensed event that constitutes a command is a physical manipulation of an object or body in space, or the emitted result is actuation or placement in space with no rendered layer required. The interface's layout is described in room coordinates, zones, and objects rather than in windows and widgets.

dimension.category_description: How interaction crosses sensory, physical, spatial, embodied, or representational channels.
dimension.classification_boundary: The channel, embodiment, or rendering must be the load-bearing interface mechanism.
